question: How will my career go, and when is the best time for a job change?

drafts.summary: Career is supported by five of the seven families with none against: the lord vote rests on Venus, the exalted lord of the 6th, and Mercury, lord of the 2nd, placed in the 10th, the Sun and Mercury form a Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga in the 10th, and the house vote stays for career although the 10th itself has the lowest Bhava Bala of its houses at 4.51 rupas, its lord Saturn standing at a Shadbala ratio of 0.69 [vote:career.lord] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [vote:career.house]. For a change of job, the career window the engine scores highest is 2029-10-23 to 2032-06-23, the Jupiter–Venus sub-period, whose lord Venus is exalted and rules the 6th, though in its strongest stretch, 2030-05-01 to 2030-09-22, Saturn transits the 8th and Jupiter the 1st from the Moon, both graded adverse [fact:timing.career.windows.0] [fact:timing.career.windows.1.score] [fact:timing.career.windows.2.score] [fact:vimshottari.periods.Jupiter-Venus] [fact:planets.Venus.dignity] [fact:lordship.Venus] [fact:transits.rows.92] [fact:transits.rows.93]. The nearer windows, 2026-10-21 to 2027-01-24 and 2027-10-20 to 2028-02-23, fall in the Jupiter–Mercury sub-period with Saturn in the 6th from the Moon graded favourable, and the engine marks 2028-11-17 to 2029-08-08, in the Jupiter–Ketu sub-period, as the span to avoid [fact:timing.career.windows.2] [fact:timing.career.windows.1] [fact:transits.rows.0] [fact:transits.rows.30] [fact:timing.career.avoid].

The Sun, lord of the 4th, and Mercury, lord of the 2nd and 5th, are conjunct in the 10th, a career house, forming a Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga at full scale, read for authority, reputation and career [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/34/11-12].

Mars, in its own sign Scorpio, forms Ruchaka yoga from the lagna, in the 7th, the 10th's Bhavat Bhavam, and from the Sun, in the 10th from the Sun, a career house; each fire is scaled to 0.408 for Saturn's aspect, Mars's adverse tara from the Moon and its marana karaka sthana [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [text:BPHS/Santhanam-1984/75/1-2] [fact:planets.Mars.dignity] [fact:planets.Mars.sign].

The house vote is for career: with the lagna, Moon and Sun weighted 3:2:1, the 10th from the lagna, Aquarius, has the lowest relative Bhava Bala at 4.51 rupas, while the 2nd (8.93), 11th (8.23) and 6th (8.22) from the lagna and the 11th from the Sun (8.95) and from the Moon (8.51) stand above it [vote:career.house].

The lord vote is for career: Saturn, lord of the 10th, sits in a friend's sign in the 1st at a Shadbala ratio of 0.69, but Venus, lord of the 6th, is exalted in the 11th at 1.33, Mercury, lord of the 2nd, is in the 10th at 1.19, and Mars, lord of the 7th and of the 10th from the Sun, is in its own sign at 1.3 [vote:career.lord].

The karaka vote is for career: the Sun (Shadbala ratio 1.23, in an enemy's sign) and Mercury (1.19, neutral) occupy the 10th, Venus is exalted in Pisces at 1.33 and occupies a career house from the lagna, the Moon and the Sun, and Saturn, in a friend's sign in the 1st at 0.69, is the one karaka below a ratio of 1 [vote:career.karaka].

The varga vote is for career: in the dasamsa (D10), Mars in Capricorn, its exaltation, scores 1.0 and Saturn in its own sign Capricorn 0.5, the Sun in Scorpio, Jupiter in Aries and Venus in Gemini score 0.25 each, and the Moon in Libra and Mercury in Aquarius score 0 [vote:career.varga].

The panchanga vote is for career: Mars, lord of the birth tithi and nakshatra, rules the 7th (the 10th's Bhavat Bhavam), the 2nd and 7th from the Moon and the 10th from the Sun at a Shadbala ratio of 1.3, and the Moon, lord of the weekday, rules the 10th from the Moon and the 6th from the Sun at 1.27 [vote:career.panchanga].

Saturn, lord of the 10th, sits in Taurus in the 1st in a friend's sign; its sign chain runs through Venus, exalted in Pisces in the 11th, to Jupiter in Taurus and ends in the Jupiter–Venus loop, and its nakshatra chain runs from Krittika through the Sun, Jupiter, the Moon and Mars to end in the Mars–Mercury loop. In its navamsa chain Saturn is in its own sign Capricorn, the 12th from the D9 lagna, and is its own final dispositor, and it is in neither current period's activation set [chain:career.lord].

The Sun, the area's main karaka, sits in Aquarius in the 10th in an enemy's sign; its sign chain runs through Saturn and Venus to Jupiter and ends in the Jupiter–Venus loop, and its nakshatra chain runs from PurvaBhadra through Jupiter, the Moon and Mars to the Mars–Mercury loop. Its navamsa chain runs from Gemini through Mercury and Venus to Saturn, self-disposited in Capricorn, and the current major period of Jupiter activates the Sun, which is in a nakshatra of Jupiter [chain:career.karaka].

Saturn's sign chain ends in the Jupiter–Venus loop, so the 10th lord's results are finally disposed by Jupiter and by Venus, which is exalted at a Shadbala ratio of 1.33 [chain:career.lord] [fact:planets.Venus.dignity] [fact:shadbala.planets.Venus.ratio]. The house vote still comes out for career because it weighs the 2nd, 6th and 11th, career houses at 8.93, 8.22 and 8.23 rupas, against the 10th, so I read the area's support as running through those houses and the planets in the 10th rather than through the 10th's own strength [vote:career.house]. Ruchaka yoga is cut to 0.408 by Saturn's aspect, Mars's Pratyak tara and its marana karaka sthana, while Mars is exalted in the dasamsa, so I credit Mars through the lord and varga votes rather than through the yoga [rule:yoga.ruchaka] [fact:planets.Mars.tara] [vote:career.lord] [vote:career.varga]. The KP vote abstains: the 10th cusp falls in a star of the Moon with Ketu as sub-lord, and both Ketu's star lord Venus and Ketu itself, through its sign lord Jupiter, signify the 11th together with the 1st, a denial house, so that school neither confirms nor denies the area [fact:lagnas.kp_cusps.H10] [fact:areas.career.votes.kp.derivation] [fact:areas.career.votes.kp.vote]. The engine flags intensity for this area, touching the 10th house, its lord Saturn and the karaka Sun [fact:areas.career.polarity_touches.intensity]. Brihat Jataka reads the source of earnings from the planets in the tenth from the lagna, the Moon and the Sun, and the kind of work from the lord of the navamsa held by the lord of the tenth [tradition:Brihat Jataka 10]. In this chart the 10th from the lagna holds the Sun and Mercury, the 10th from the Moon is empty and the 10th from the Sun holds Mars, while the 10th lord Saturn occupies its own sign Capricorn in the navamsa [fact:sudarshana_h10.from_lagna] [fact:sudarshana_h10.from_moon] [fact:sudarshana_h10.from_sun] [fact:lordship.Saturn] [fact:vargas.D9.Saturn]. Saturn, lord of the 10th, occupies the 1st [fact:lordship.Saturn] [fact:planets.Saturn.house]. Ranked for this area: first the lords of the 2nd, 6th and 11th led by the exalted Venus, which carry the lord vote; second the Sun and Mercury in the 10th with their Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga; third the 10th lord Saturn below its required strength, which limits the 10th itself; fourth the dasamsa dignities of Mars and Saturn, which carry the varga vote; last the Ruchaka yoga as discounted [vote:career.lord] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [fact:shadbala.planets.Saturn.ratio] [vote:career.varga] [rule:yoga.ruchaka].
